topic: Heat treatment of Iron and its alloys
syllabus_extract: Heat treatment of Iron and its alloys. Advantages, procedure and different types of heat treatment
specific_objectives: 18.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to understand and know the heat treatments of Iron and alloys.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of heating and quenching procedures with safety precautions; Instructor supervision required
intro_questions: Why is heat treatment necessary for iron alloys?
List the basic steps of a heat treatment cycle.

topics: Definition and purpose of heat treatment
development.content:
Definition and purpose of heat treatment
Advantages of heat treatment processes
General procedure and equipment used

Annealing process and applications
Normalizing process and grain structure
Hardening and quenching techniques

topics: Comparison of different heat treatment types
development.content:
Tempering process and stress relief
Comparison of different heat treatment types
Selection criteria for specific alloys

summary_questions: Explain the difference between annealing and normalizing.
Describe the role of quenching in the hardening process.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how heat treatment affects the mechanical properties of piston engine components, linking to the stress concepts covered in LP 09.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to Stress & Strain, various types of stress and strain, explanation using stress strain diagram of various metals, Hooks law, factor of safety and other terminologies.
